nodes.norm_label: diagnostic export evaluates current placement and retained actual search results without launching a new search
nodes.rationale: Pure export never launches search. Matching date/owner selects retained actual history; missing/mismatched runs fabricate nothing. Completeness/evaluatedPeople use assigned IDs including guests separately from member-only welfare distributions.

nodes.label: Search history records bounded initial candidates and sampled search phases from the actual deterministic run
nodes.norm_label: search history records bounded initial candidates and sampled search phases from the actual deterministic run
nodes.rationale: Samples are not an exhaustive distribution, satisfaction measure, percentile, or guarantee of global optimality.

nodes.label: Client and Rules share normalized role membership
nodes.norm_label: client and rules share normalized role membership
nodes.rationale: Client normalizes email and validates admin/master enum; Firestore rules use trimmed/lower token email and same enum before granting data access. Admin self-get supports status lookup; list/mutations require master, and UI edit mode is not a security rule.

nodes.label: Only normalized server admin roles grant access
nodes.norm_label: only normalized server admin roles grant access
nodes.rationale: Trim/lower email before getDocFromServer. Missing document, failure, absent/invalid role deny access. Only admin/master roles grant isAdmin, master alone grants isMaster. No personal email bootstrap remains.

nodes.label: Real client module role regression tests
nodes.norm_label: real client module role regression tests
nodes.rationale: Mocks Firebase I/O while importing actual checkAdminStatus. Test former personal address without server doc, ordinary absent doc, valid/invalid/absent role values, normalized lookup and failed lookup denial. Test source is coverage evidence, not a new run by this worker.

nodes.label: CSV preserves session and exact group identities
nodes.norm_label: csv preserves session and exact group identities
nodes.rationale: Readable columns accompany session ID, JSON group or null for empty session, and board ID list. Independent identical-date/name sessions remain distinct. Missing board snapshot stays blank; explicit [] remains JSON [].

nodes.label: CSV groups by explicit identity and retains legacy parsing
nodes.norm_label: csv groups by explicit identity and retains legacy parsing
nodes.rationale: Explicit IDs are validated, same-ID date/name must agree, and JSON group metadata restores exact IDs. No-ID legacy input groups by date/name. Exact guest token increments anonymous count; unknown names do not. Role absence differs from empty snapshot.

nodes.label: Guest counts normalize and participate in group merges
nodes.norm_label: guest counts normalize and participate in group merges
nodes.rationale: Absent legacy count becomes zero; reject non-safe-integer or negative values. Normalization emits known group fields. Unchanged edited groups retain remote changes; changed/deleted groups apply groupwise.

nodes.label: Atomic import refuses any existing session ID
nodes.norm_label: atomic import refuses any existing session id
nodes.rationale: At most 400 sessions, supplied IDs preserved and missing IDs allocated. Transaction reads all targets, aborts every write if any exists, and audits success; no overwriting of history.

nodes.label: Session deletion detaches exact linked planning
nodes.norm_label: session deletion detaches exact linked planning
nodes.rationale: Find DailyPlannings by sessionId rather than date/name. One batch removes only matching sessionId fields, deletes session and audits; preserve planning contents and fail on lookup/commit or excessive links. Read-before-batch leaves concurrent-new-link window.

nodes.label: Edits preserve anonymous guests and archived roles
nodes.norm_label: edits preserve anonymous guests and archived roles
nodes.rationale: General save merges group edits and keeps stored boardMemberIds; game-only save copies target current group changing only gameIds. Audit includes guest counts. Read-before-batch is not transactional isolation for concurrent edits.

nodes.label: Responsive short semester option selection
nodes.summary: The same-year namesake scenario runs at 390 and 1280px, selects the exact option avalon4 · 24-2, chooses another member by ID, edits a row, renews replacement/unregistered acknowledgements after edits, verifies width containment, and checks selected nicknames in the pool. Local fixture only; this is test definition evidence, not an assertion of production authenticated testing.

nodes.label: Attendee-to-member storage conversion
nodes.rationale: Confirmed conversion removes explicit guest attendee IDs into anonymous guestCount; real attendees resolve stable member IDs, unmatched fallback retains attendee ID. Production meeting-start rejects unresolved non-guests before conversion.

nodes.label: Selected identity in active personal utility
nodes.norm_label: selected identity in active personal utility
nodes.rationale: Skip absent/unmatched non-guests, reject duplicate member identity, translate past member IDs into active attendee IDs. Explicit guests count in sizing/requests with null membership/gender/year and false board, no historical exposures; welfare protection filters guests out.

nodes.label: Operating snapshots preserve guest IDs until anonymization
nodes.norm_label: operating snapshots preserve guest ids until anonymization
nodes.rationale: Planning groups keep guest attendee IDs alongside real member IDs; attendee snapshot supplies guest name/drink/invitation. Confirmed-session conversion removes guest identities into counts.

nodes.label: Meeting start converts assigned attendee IDs to member IDs and stores member-linked planning snapshots
nodes.norm_label: meeting start converts assigned attendee ids to member ids and stores member-linked planning snapshots
nodes.rationale: Working groups use attendee IDs. Meeting start rejects deleted/unregistered non-guests, keeps named guest/relationship/drinks in planning snapshots and anonymous guestCount in confirmed history. Archive replaced planning, preserve old independent sessions, and change only assigned statuses.

nodes.label: Confirmation binds the reviewed identity snapshot
nodes.norm_label: confirmation binds the reviewed identity snapshot
nodes.rationale: Input/count/member ID/name/student ID and nickname-semester labels bind replacement/unregistered acknowledgements. Edits invalidate acknowledgements; confirm freezes resolved IDs for service revalidation. Guest data participates through input.

nodes.label: CSV confirmation column and namesake list share semester labels
nodes.norm_label: csv confirmation column and namesake list share semester labels
nodes.rationale: Both mobile and desktop reuse rowActions with member-ID option values and shared nickname/semester labels. Single linked member has label/title; guest name/drink appears separately.

nodes.label: Reviewed CSV rows and namesake selection
nodes.norm_label: reviewed csv rows and namesake selection
nodes.rationale: Original row numbers key edits; name/prefix candidates, validated explicit selected IDs and distinguishable display labels prevent arbitrary namesake selection. Duplicate selected member rows fail; unresolved names/years warn as unregistered.

nodes.label: Nickname and short join semester display
nodes.norm_label: nickname and short join semester display
nodes.rationale: Display trims nickname/semester, shortens exact YYYY-1/2 to YY-1/2, preserves nonmatching semesters and uses missing-semester label. Equal display labels are ambiguous; storage is never migrated.

nodes.label: Optional guest form columns preserve legacy imports
nodes.norm_label: optional guest form columns preserve legacy imports
nodes.rationale: Omitted guest fields preserve legacy input. Yes/name/drink implies guest; name and member-resolved inviter required; unknown response and conflicting no/details fail. Guest drink optional, guest people/drinks count toward totals.

nodes.label: Scenario Lab mirrors identity without Firestore
nodes.norm_label: scenario lab mirrors identity without firestore
nodes.rationale: Local fixture import preserves memberId/null and unregistered acknowledgement, quick-add links synthetic member. This is not production persistence validation; canonical importer maps member rows without creating production guest records.

nodes.label: Design Lab browser timezone
nodes.summary: Configured page/context fixture timezoneId is Asia/Seoul. Serial Chromium Design Lab uses only local app/emulator; timezone setting is separate from host TZ.

nodes.label: Attendance identity: ID / null / absent
nodes.rationale: Stored memberId selects durable identity; null explicitly means unregistered; absent allows legacy lookup. participantType guest overrides name lookup and prevents same-name membership.

nodes.label: Explicit guest identity overrides member lookup
nodes.norm_label: explicit guest identity overrides member lookup
nodes.rationale: participantType guest prevents same-name resolution even with absent memberId. Inviter is an attendee ID; missing, absent or unregistered inviter produces warning, while validation requires attending registered member.

nodes.label: Automatic assignment retains a cloned completed run and aborts pending work when its input dependencies change or unmount
nodes.norm_label: automatic assignment retains a cloned completed run and aborts pending work when its input dependencies change or unmount
nodes.rationale: Input changes or unmount abort pending assignment; only completed nonaborted run updates groups and cloned diagnostics. Export is blocked during active search.

nodes.label: Fresh member lookup revalidates reviewed attendance identities before one roster replacement batch
nodes.norm_label: fresh member lookup revalidates reviewed attendance identities before one roster replacement batch
nodes.rationale: Fetch fresh members and rebuild preview. Lookup/validation/acknowledgement/write-limit errors abort before mutation. One batch replaces roster, creates guest with new inviter attendee ID, restores dormant members and audits guest-inclusive totals. Guest writes count toward 500 limit.

nodes.label: Manual attendance rejects ambiguous namesakes instead of choosing one
nodes.norm_label: manual attendance rejects ambiguous namesakes instead of choosing one
nodes.rationale: Normal manual member add refuses ambiguous name/prefix matches. Explicit guests are excluded from member duplicate checks, so same-name guests do not block real member attendance.

nodes.label: Repeated guest names and inviters keep distinct identities
nodes.norm_label: repeated guest names and inviters keep distinct identities
nodes.rationale: Each manual add allocates fresh guest document, writes memberId null, optional drink and inviter attendee ID, omits student/afterparty data and creates no member. Transaction rechecks inviter existence/absence; membership validation uses supplied snapshot.

nodes.label: Quick registration atomically creates a member and links attendee.memberId to its generated ID
nodes.norm_label: quick registration atomically creates a member and links attendee.memberid to its generated id
nodes.rationale: Reject explicit guests, validate against fresh members, atomically create member, update attendee memberId and add audit. No guest becomes member through this shortcut.

nodes.label: Maintained text input inventory
nodes.rationale: Walk fixed source/test/script/doc/CI/public roots and selected root text files; skip symlinks and generated or sensitive paths, deduplicate and hash files. This scanner supplies candidate paths; the Graphify wrapper separately normalizes UTF-8 line endings and includes Python scripts.

nodes.label: Portable content-based graph freshness
nodes.rationale: The wrapper hashes LF-normalized maintained inputs and controls. Artifact bytes must match verified hashes. Input digest equality determines freshness independently of commit identity; commit IDs remain provenance. Inventory uses the project inventory helper and augments scripts with Python sources.

nodes.label: Graph freshness and evidence regression guards
nodes.norm_label: graph freshness and evidence regression guards
nodes.rationale: Synthetic tests cover body-only/staged/new/Python inputs, rename/deletion, generated exclusions, toolchain/exclusion changes, LF/CRLF portability, same-content commits, artifact tampering, source coverage and edge validity, lost unchanged symbols/relations, and distinct six-case review evidence. They test verification mechanics, not semantic completeness of the app graph.

nodes.label: Charts union attendance by local date
nodes.norm_label: charts union attendance by local date
nodes.rationale: Read-only projection sorts local dates, skips invalid dates and unions member IDs across same-day sessions. Stored session identities remain independent. Guest counts do not become member attendance.

nodes.label: Ranking counts independent sessions
nodes.rationale: Deduplicate within each session then count every independent session even on same day. Filter nonexistent members; stored board snapshot precedes current roster flag and [] denotes no past board members.

nodes.label: Disabled dragging preserves nested controls
nodes.summary: Disabled drag cards omit draggable accessibility attributes; button/input/select/link event targets bypass drag handlers. Unregistered registration/delete controls remain usable.

nodes.label: Visible pool collision and drag scroll confinement
nodes.norm_label: visible pool collision and drag scroll confinement
nodes.summary: For pointer drags, accept pool drops only inside the visible inner pool rectangle. While inside, programmatic scrolling is allowed only for that pool; outside, pool scrolling is disabled and ancestor/page scrolling can resume. Keyboard collision uses closestCenter; pointer clipping does not apply to keyboard geometry.

nodes.label: Bounded keyboard-accessible roster scroll region
nodes.rationale: Mobile/desktop height caps retain header outside labelled focusable scroll area. Registered attendees and explicit guests drag; unresolved non-guests do not. Guests suppress quick registration and first-visit notices.

nodes.label: Synthetic pool scroll and collision tests
nodes.norm_label: synthetic pool scroll and collision tests
nodes.summary: Scenario tests assert touch/wheel/keyboard internal scrolling, fixed page/header, internal edge-scroll stop/cancel, page scroll outside, clipped-content drop rejection and empty return pool.

nodes.label: Applied buttons remain after proposal API removal
nodes.norm_label: applied buttons remain after proposal api removal
nodes.rationale: Direct attendanceButtonStyles and fixed evaluation label remain; old appearance/label override props and scenario proposal APIs are removed. This does not remove production CostEvaluationModal.

nodes.label: Browser contract: desktop name/padding selects once while action buttons and mobile name do not select
nodes.norm_label: browser contract: desktop name/padding selects once while action buttons and mobile name do not select

nodes.norm_label: tests memo-only atomic audit, deleted members, retries, conflicts and idempotent writes

nodes.norm_label: general member edit batches the full form data and audit changes using the current subscription snapshot

nodes.norm_label: memo-only transaction compares expected text, rejects deleted members, and atomically records memo audit changes
nodes.rationale: Only this dedicated memo operation provides text conflict checks. A desired value already on the server is an idempotent no-op before the expected-value check.

nodes.label: Default message changes preserve saved templates
nodes.norm_label: default message changes preserve saved templates
nodes.rationale: Saved template fields override six defaults. Supported supplied brace placeholders replace; unknown/missing values remain. Recruitment cohort/account bracket items require manual editing; selected default includes 20,000won fee.

nodes.label: Tests conflict reload, failed input retention and late-save isolation across profiles
nodes.norm_label: tests conflict reload, failed input retention and late-save isolation across profiles

nodes.norm_label: browser contract saves and reopens profile memo at 320px and 390px

nodes.norm_label: member memo editor keeps failed/conflicting input, blocks duplicate pending saves, and ignores completion after unmount

nodes.norm_label: settings admin controls reserved for master
nodes.rationale: Only master mounts admin panel/confirmation and enables admin hook. Ordinary operators retain settings/export without attempting prohibited admin-list request; audit panel also needs master and edit mode.

nodes.label: Disabled settings skip privileged list and mutations
nodes.norm_label: disabled settings skip privileged list and mutations
nodes.rationale: enabled gates fetch, add and delete; SettingsPage passes isMasterAdmin. Normalize added email and reject duplicates through service; prevent repeated deletion, protect master in UI and retain failure modal for retry. Server rules remain authority.

nodes.label: Local Emulator master and operator UI tests
nodes.norm_label: local emulator master and operator ui tests
nodes.rationale: Synthetic localhost/demo fixture tests master adding normalized ordinary admin and deleting it, master delete control absence, and ordinary operator settings without forbidden list error. Emulator admin bypass is used only for fixture/readback.

nodes.label: Explicit identity and legacy lookup boundary
nodes.norm_label: explicit identity and legacy lookup boundary
nodes.summary: An explicit ID finds only that ID; null and nonexistent IDs return undefined without name matching. With no ID, isSameName filters names, prefix matches full or two-digit student year, and a prefix miss falls back to the first name match.

nodes.label: Explicit ID and legacy-prefix fallback tests
nodes.norm_label: explicit id and legacy-prefix fallback tests
nodes.summary: Tests explicitly cover renaming, null, deleted ID, namesake selected ID, and absent-ID prefix mismatch falling back to first matching name.

nodes.norm_label: tests invalid csv rows reject all games with original row numbers

nodes.norm_label: tests permit a positive bound paired with unspecified zero

nodes.norm_label: tests memo edits preserve zeros and invalid drafts produce no batch write

nodes.norm_label: any invalid player-range row rejects the whole csv before writes with one-based row issues

nodes.norm_label: tests pending flush locks close and failure retains notes and blocks action-needed transition

nodes.norm_label: flush saves latest local note through the serial queue and reports success only in the same generation with the saved revision

nodes.norm_label: interview draft save queue and callbacks belong to one applicant/round generation

nodes.norm_label: restore one coherent verified graphify bundle

nodes.norm_label: candidate extraction is sealed and independently reviewed

nodes.norm_label: content and artifact hashes determine graph freshness

nodes.norm_label: graphify runtime is pinned to graphifyy0.9.84

nodes.norm_label: only seven reviewed graphify artifacts are shared

nodes.norm_label: six source-backed verification cases guard meaning
nodes.rationale: Verify identity conversion, absence/empty, planning/session writes, shared storage, public auth/legacy and damage/body-only changes.

nodes.label: Graphify is supplementary to source tests and Rules
nodes.norm_label: graphify is supplementary to source tests and rules
nodes.rationale: Missing graph links are not proof of absent impact; maintained text and storage consumers require direct review.

nodes.label: Host semantic token totals may be unmeasured
nodes.norm_label: host semantic token totals may be unmeasured

nodes.label: New computers clone avalon-club-manager main
nodes.rationale: Tracked source tests Rules guides and graph travel together; old chat/local caches are unnecessary.

nodes.label: Graph status needs Node and Git without installed Graphify
nodes.norm_label: graph status needs node and git without installed graphify

nodes.label: Local synthetic labs need explicit runtime prerequisites
nodes.norm_label: local synthetic labs need explicit runtime prerequisites

nodes.label: main CI does not automatically deploy the application
nodes.norm_label: main ci does not automatically deploy the application

nodes.label: Firebase target configuration is tracked
nodes.rationale: No private environment file is required to install or run the isolated local app.

nodes.label: Install pinned local Graphify only for querying or rebuilding
nodes.norm_label: install pinned local graphify only for querying or rebuilding

nodes.label: GitHub Firebase IAM and application admin access are separate
nodes.norm_label: github firebase iam and application admin access are separate
nodes.rationale: Firebase login alone does not grant deployment authority; application roles are separate again.

nodes.label: Ambiguous mentions require an explicit candidate choice
nodes.norm_label: ambiguous mentions require an explicit candidate choice
nodes.rationale: Resolve only that mention while preserving other confirmed requests; bind local selection to identity and date.

nodes.label: Bounded movable companion-pair exchanges supplement individual search
nodes.norm_label: bounded movable companion-pair exchanges supplement individual search
nodes.rationale: Only improving lexicographic candidates apply; 2000 pair evaluations per initial placement do not prove global optimality.

nodes.label: Diagnostic schema and model identifiers describe data meaning
nodes.norm_label: diagnostic schema and model identifiers describe data meaning
nodes.rationale: schemaVersion1 and personal-utility-v3 are technical identifiers, not product release history.

nodes.label: Search diagnostics stay in screen memory with anonymous local IDs
nodes.norm_label: search diagnostics stay in screen memory with anonymous local ids
nodes.rationale: Reload removes automaticRun; comparisons require matching contexts and fully assigned groups.

nodes.label: Recorded search samples are not global assignment percentiles
nodes.norm_label: recorded search samples are not global assignment percentiles
nodes.rationale: Eight actual initial candidates and bounded search traces do not constitute random global samples.

nodes.label: Same and other gender utility use saturating exponentials
nodes.norm_label: same and other gender utility use saturating exponentials
nodes.rationale: First same-gender gain is larger and saturates faster; defaults are provisional rather than observed satisfaction.

nodes.label: Companion matching uses full names and Korean short names literally
nodes.norm_label: companion matching uses full names and korean short names literally
nodes.rationale: Substring matching accepts embedded characters and does not infer sentence negation or use AI.

nodes.label: Global relative protection precedes request attenuation
nodes.norm_label: global relative protection precedes request attenuation
nodes.rationale: All people determine the protection baseline; reunion cost is restored separately so attenuation never erases it.

nodes.label: Current utility parameters are initial operating values
nodes.norm_label: current utility parameters are initial operating values
nodes.rationale: Gender first gains 0.9/0.25, attenuation .25, reunion .35/2/.6 and protection scale2 are not satisfaction estimates.

nodes.label: Satisfied direct companions attenuate composition costs
nodes.norm_label: satisfied direct companions attenuate composition costs
nodes.rationale: Use exp(-0.25 n_i); unsatisfied companions do not contribute attenuation.

nodes.label: BigInt request product implements log marginal satisfaction
nodes.norm_label: bigint request product implements log marginal satisfaction
nodes.rationale: P=product(1+n_i) preserves ordering without floating-point ties; direct pairs are undirected and deduplicated.

nodes.label: Reunion exposure decays by personal attendance order
nodes.norm_label: reunion exposure decays by personal attendance order
nodes.rationale: Only prior confirmed sessions count; absence and calendar time do not increment decay steps.

nodes.label: School-year cost uses a stable soft minimum
nodes.norm_label: school-year cost uses a stable soft minimum
nodes.rationale: Absolute differences are direction-independent; nearby peers reduce burden without excluding distant peers.

nodes.norm_label: all unlisted document paths deny reads/writes

nodes.norm_label: dailyplanning snapshots append-only versions with server time and caller email; updates denied

nodes.norm_label: admins self-get/master-list; strict master-created ordinary admin; master deletes ordinary admin only

nodes.label: Operator append-only auditEvents; only master reads
nodes.norm_label: operator append-only auditevents; only master reads

nodes.norm_label: rules enforce overall allowed slots rather than dynamic kst four-day ui window
nodes.rationale: Spark-compatible client calendar policy cannot be fully generated/validated inside Rules.

nodes.norm_label: create core fields and changed-field legacy updates for members/games/sessions

nodes.norm_label: guestcount absent zero; nonnegative safe integer normalization

nodes.norm_label: dailyplanning retains guest attendee identity/name/drink/inviter snapshot
